BrochureContent.Content: Gallagher Auctioneers are delighted to bring to the market this two double bedroom top floor apartment in Carrick on Shannon. Located on an elevated site within walking distance of all town centre amenities.  Accommodation comprises of entrance hall, two double bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, bathroom and open plan reception room/kitchen/diner with access onto balcony. The property has ample parking & the balcony has some views of the River Shannon. Located within a short walk of the town centre with all that Carrick on Shannon has to offer such as shops, restaurants, coffee shops, cinema, The Dock Theatre, Aura Leisure Centre and beautiful walkways along the River Shannon. Carrick on Shannon train station is also within close proximity with 5/7 trains daily serving the Sligo/Dublin Line.  For all viewings contact Gallagher Auctioneers on 0719621000.
